ios.desc:
Put your color-matching skills to the test with the Blingiest, most rewarding match-3 game on the market! Bitcoin Blast combines your love of crypto with your need for brain-stimulating puzzles.  

Blast your way through hundreds of strategic levels with progressive difficulty. Focus on creating colorful combos--the longer the Bitcoin chain the bigger the explosions! Collect diamonds/rubies, shatter stones, and crack the safes by matching the “Bitcoin” with like-colored coins.  

Each level creates a unique opportunity for you test your puzzle-solving skills. Make sure to think ahead as moves you make now can affect the outcome of level; keep your eye on the timer as some levels give you less time to think. Make longer chains to score higher star values.  

Use long chains in combination with epic powerups to get the most bang out of your BTC. Crack the Bitcoin and earn Bling Points in-app if you log into your Bling account.  

Features:  
Hundreds of Levels 
Solve Strategic Puzzles  
Test Your Skills With Progressive Difficulty 
Create Colorful Combos  
Bitcoin Themed
